$comment: The brand marks, pinned by sha256. `brand-doctor` rule 9 fails if any
The logo is the source of truth for the whole visual system and the one
asset that is not derived from anything — the rest of the brand is
derived from IT. Everything else in this repository that carries a
colour is generated from a token module and locked byte-for-byte; these
eleven files were governed by a sentence in a document asking people
Two masters were provided and are archival. Nine files are downscales
or re-encodes of them, which is permitted — re-encoding is fine,
redrawing is not — so they are pinned too: a re-export at a different
quality is still a change to what a reader sees, and it should be a
decision rather than a diff nobody reads.
To change one deliberately: replace the file, run
`npm run brand:marks:update`, and say why in the commit.
